simple.summary: נֶקֶב (Neqeb) means Nekeb , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 33.

definitions.full: H5346. Neqeb נֶ֫קֶב proper name, of a location only in הַנּ ׳אֲדָמִי Josh 19:33 ( ᵐ5 Αρμε καὶ Ναβωκ ; A. Αρμαι καὶ Νακεβ ; ᵐ5 L Αδεμμη αννεκβ ); on border of Naphtali; apparently a pass (Arabic , road between, mountains ).
